summary: WorldEntity GenerationOrigin accepts generatorVersion values that canonical deterministic generation cannot replay. cloneOrigin only requires a finite positive integer, so 2147483648 is accepted into durable entity provenance, while DeterminismContract.seedFor and the normative determinism contract restrict generationVersion to [1, 2147483647]. Align WorldEntity origin validation with the canonical generator-version contract and add max/max+1 boundary regressions; prefer a shared contract/helper if available rather than duplicating a magic number.
evidence: src/shared/Reality/WorldEntity.luau cloneOrigin validates origin.generatorVersion only as finite, >=1, integer and stores it unchanged in immutable GenerationOrigin.
src/shared/Core/DeterminismContract.luau seedFor requires generationVersion to be a safe integer in [1, 2147483647].
Docs/DETERMINISM_CONTRACT.md normatively defines generationVersion as an explicit integer in [1, 2147483647] and requires persisted generator/contract versions to reconstruct historical truth.
Docs/ARCHITECTURE.md defines GenerationOrigin as the WorldId/RegionId/generator name/version/recipe-key provenance for WorldEntity persistence across representation changes.
PR #271 comment 5250030735 records the actionable source handoff.
